title: Composition of instruction effects
statement: Fix a word width $W$, a program instruction type, two finite instruction lists $l_1,l_2$, and a memory $m$ assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address. Applying the instructions in the concatenated list $l_1 ++ l_2$ to $m$ gives the same memory as first applying $l_1$ and then applying $l_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Two instruction lists l₁ and l₂
